For over 5 years, Arthur has been professionally covering video games, writing guides and walkthroughs. His passion for video games began at age 10 in 2010 when he first played Gothic , an immersive classic that immediately hooked him on rich storytelling, open-world exploration, and character development. This early experience sparked a lifelong love for RPGs, leading him to dive deep into The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim , where he spent countless hours building characters, exploring vast fantasy worlds, and getting lost in epic narratives.
Over the years, his interests expanded into competitive multiplayer gaming. He has invested significant time in Counter-Strike (both older versions and CS:GO/CS2) for its intense tactical gameplay and Dota 2 for its strategic depth, team coordination, and ever-evolving meta. Gaming remains one of his greatest passions, combining creativity, problem-solving, and community, and it continues to influence his perspective as a guide writer.
In Ishin , you step into everyday student life full of classes, plant experiments that can get messy, fights with different styles, basketball games, and music performances with friends. Building your own space and standing out from the crowd takes time, which is why working codes matter so much in this Roblox game . Codes hand out free Yen and Rerolls that speed up buying clothes, furniture, and new looks so you can jump into all the fun activities faster instead of grinding for every little item.
Rerolls give you extra chances to redesign your character whenever you want a new face, hair, or outfit that fits the mood of the day.
Yen works as the main currency you use to buy clothes, furniture, or other things that make your room and style stand out. Having extra of both means you can try different looks for class, fights, or concerts without needing to collect as much currency the regular way.
Yen also helps when you want to decorate your living space right after you start playing, so the place feels personal from the beginning.
Press the Tab key once your character loads to open the main menu.

If nothing happens after you claim, check that you copied the code exactly and try again.
